extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: crawler dozer (approx. 20 t class), approx. 6.1 x 3.4 x 3.2 m (L x W x H), blade width 3.4 m, track length 3.5 m
extras.notes: front (blade) faces -Y; the blade with its push arms and cylinder rods 'bulldozer_blade' is a separate object with its origin on the push-arm trunnions at the track frames (rotate around local X: a negative angle lifts the blade, approx. 0 to -12 degrees, a positive angle tilts it down); lift cylinders are split: barrels on the hood, rods on the blade; rear ripper and tracks are static; amber beacon glows softly; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
